description: This file implements profile management and reporting logic for telemetry, including profile creation, enabling/disabling, event handling, report collection, and trigger conditions. It interacts with external modules for scheduling, network communication, and JSON processing.

classes.name: triggerConditionObj
classes.description: Structure representing a trigger condition with reference name and value.

methods.name: freeRequestURIparam
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for HTTP request URI parameters.

methods.name: freeReportProfileConfig
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a report profile configuration.

methods.name: freeProfile
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a Profile object and its internal members.

methods.name: getProfile
methods.description: Retrieves a profile by name from the profile list.

methods.name: initJSONReportProfile
methods.description: Initializes a JSON report profile object with a root name and array.

methods.name: profileWithNameExists
methods.description: Checks if a profile with the given name exists.

methods.name: getMarkerCompRbusSub
methods.description: Subscribes or unsubscribes to component marker events via RBUS.

methods.name: CollectAndReport
methods.description: Main thread function for collecting data and reporting for a profile, runs in a loop.

methods.name: NotifyTimeout
methods.description: Triggers report collection for a profile if enabled and not already in progress.

methods.name: Profile_storeMarkerEvent
methods.description: Stores an event marker for a profile, updating counts or values accordingly.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a new profile to the profile list.

methods.name: enableProfile
methods.description: Enables a profile and registers it with scheduler and event markers.

methods.name: updateMarkerComponentMap
methods.description: Updates component mapping for all enabled profiles.

methods.name: disableProfile
methods.description: Disables a profile and updates scheduler status.

methods.name: deleteAllProfiles
methods.description: Deletes all profiles, optionally removing from disk.

methods.name: isProfileEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a profile is enabled.

methods.name: deleteProfile
methods.description: Deletes a specific profile, cleaning up resources and unregistering from scheduler.

methods.name: sendLogUploadInterruptToScheduler
methods.description: Sends interrupt signals to profiles with markers to trigger log uploads.

methods.name: loadReportProfilesFromDisk
methods.description: Loads report profiles from disk, including JSON and MsgPack formats, and creates profiles.

methods.name: initProfileList
methods.description: Initializes the profile list and loads profiles from disk.

methods.name: getProfileCount
methods.description: Returns the number of profiles in the list.

methods.name: getProfileHashMap
methods.description: Creates and returns a hash map of profile names to hashes.

methods.name: uninitProfileList
methods.description: Uninitializes the profile list, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: registerTriggerConditionConsumer
methods.description: Registers trigger condition consumers with retries.

methods.name: NotifySchedulerstart
methods.description: Updates scheduler start status for a profile.

methods.name: appendTriggerCondition
methods.description: Appends a trigger condition to a profile, or queues it if lock not acquired.

methods.name: reportGenerationCompleteReceiver
methods.description: Handles completion of report generation, processing queued trigger conditions.

methods.name: triggerReportOnCondtion
methods.description: Triggers report generation based on a specific trigger condition.

methods.name: getMinThresholdDuration
methods.description: Retrieves and resets the minimum threshold duration for a profile.
